(async()=>{const out=[];for(const tag of ['projet','theme01','equipe','cycle']){const t=performance.now();await rocksy.sidebar.selectTag(tag);await T.wait(()=>rocksy.sidebar.selectedTag===tag&&T.count('.frag')>0,3000);void rocksy.sidebar.fragList.offsetHeight;out.push([tag,+(performance.now()-t).toFixed(1),rocksy.metrics.tagFragmentsMs,rocksy.metrics.tagFragmentsCount,document.querySelector('.frag-head').textContent])}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
